technical_and_design_decisions: Development will be implemented in Go following the existing Hyperledger Fabric configtx package patterns, data structures, and protobuf manipulation conventions.
System channel genesis block creation (U6) will be provided as a dedicated API function separate from application channel genesis block creation for clearer API separation.
SigningIdentity (U8) will be extended to encapsulate both SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope as receiver methods to streamline the client API.
All new feature usage examples will be integrated into existing or new example_test.go files to maintain runnable documentation.
assumptions: The underlying helper functions for parsing dependent configuration fields mentioned in U1 are already fully implemented and unit-tested in the codebase.
The work will be performed by a single software developer familiar with Go, Hyperledger Fabric architecture, and channel configuration proto structures.
Testing and validation will rely on existing Go unit test infrastructure and standard Go documentation generation tools.

activities.activity_description: Review existing configtx package structure and design exact API function signatures for channel config retrieval, policy management, org/consortium removal, genesis block creation, and signing identity refactoring.
Implement API to retrieve the entire channel configuration as a config.Channel struct without requiring manual config transaction parsing, including unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Consortium Channel Creation Policy Management
activities.activity_description: Implement function to update the default channel creation policy ConfigValue in an existing consortium group, along with unit tests and example_test entries.
Implement API functions to add, remove, and retrieve policies on the channel group level, including unit tests and updated example tests.
Implement separate API functions for removing an organization from a consortium, application group, and orderer group, along with example tests.
Implement API function for removing a specific consortium from a channel config transaction and add corresponding example tests.

activities.activity_name: U6 - System Channel Genesis Block Creation
activities.activity_description: Implement API function to create system channel genesis blocks (populating only orderer and consortiums groups) and add corresponding example tests.
Write package-level GoDoc Overview documentation detailing library purpose, usage patterns, and channel configuration structures.
Extend SigningIdentity with SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope methods, rename functions for clarity, and update GoDocs explaining their differences.
Execute full Go test suite including all example tests, verify linting rules, inspect generated GoDocs for accuracy, and perform code cleanup.
